correctness.rationale: Every subgroup is a rotation subgroup C_a or D_2a,i, with known and independently checked embedding indices. Exact product and intersection conditions give the unitary-divisor and parity-opposite cases. The map B(hl)=l^-1 has kernel H and image L, preventing multiplicity overcount. The affine automorphism action and a two-modulus CRT yield orbit transitivity and precise orbit sizes. Every algebraic step has finite boundary checks, including direct B identities through n=10 and full orbit checks through n=24. The unrestricted proof does not depend on those checks.

value.rationale: The full image-cardinality polynomial and automorphism-orbit size census capture the number and placement of actual splitting operators, unlike coarse isomorphism/exchange factorization counts. They yield an additional sharp parity-sensitive asymptotic law: for n=2m with omega(m)->infinity, almost all splitting maps derive from two dihedral factors. These are natural classification statistics of group Rota–Baxter maps across an infinite family; not just a small table or parameter substitution.
